fields.features_heading: What a Rental Crew Needs Signed Before Setup
fields.features_subheading: Emergent builds the waiver and the lists your crew and volunteers check before anyone jumps.
fields.feature_1:
A waiver link in every booking email

The confirmation a renter gets after booking carries the waiver link. They sign on a phone the same evening, and nobody hunts for a pen on a wet lawn while the blower runs.
fields.feature_2:
One parent signs for each of their kids

A parent signs once and adds every child they brought, with an age for each. Hosts and carnival volunteers see one record per family instead of a stack of loose sheets.
fields.feature_3:
Your house rules, initialed one at a time

List your rules, such as no shoes, no flips, and small kids jumping apart from big ones. The renter initials each rule, and the form will not submit until every rule has initials.
fields.feature_4:
Reminders 48 hours before delivery

Any booking still unsigned 48 hours before its delivery time triggers an email to the renter with the waiver link. Your crew sees the status on the route list before loading.
fields.feature_5:
Search by last name at the gate

Volunteers type a family name on a tablet at the bounce house line. Signed children show with their ages and the parent who signed, and anyone missing signs on the spot.
fields.feature_6:
Code export to your GitHub repository

On paid plans, export the full code to your GitHub repository and run the waiver next to your booking system. Keep changing it by prompt, or hand it to a developer to extend.

fields.usecase_heading: Four Places the Waiver Gets Signed
fields.tab_content_1:
A reminder at 48 hours, and every stop signed by Saturday

Fiorella Lundqvist booked a Castle 13x13 from Skipwell Party Rentals for a Saturday 9:00 AM delivery. She still had not signed on Thursday at 9:00 AM, 48 hours out. The form emailed her the waiver link, and she signed at 12:40 PM. Driver Tarquin Draycott's Saturday route now shows all 4 stops as Signed.
fields.tab_content_2:
One signature per family, with each child's age on it

Anwuli Hallorann rented a bounce house for her son's 7th birthday and sent the waiver link with the invitations. Each parent signs once and lists the children coming along. Radomir Winslade signs for his two, ages 5 and 8. By Friday night, Anwuli's list shows 14 of 16 families signed and the 2 still to sign.
fields.tab_content_3:
212 children signed by 1 PM, each in a green wristband

Fairmeadow Elementary's PTA runs a fall carnival with 2 bounce houses. Families sign from a QR code at the ticket table. At the bounce house line, volunteer Gwendolen Elsdon types a last name on the booth tablet. Every child on a signed record gets a green wristband before climbing in.
fields.tab_content_4:
Wojciech initials the six slide rules one at a time

Water slides at Skipwell carry 2 rules on top of the 4 on its dry units. Wojciech Dziedzic rents the 18-foot slide for a block party and initials all 6. He names his sister, Bogna Dziedzic, as the adult who watches the slide. Her name prints on the setup checklist the driver goes over with him.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a Bounce House Waiver Form
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to create a bounce house waiver form, get the wording reviewed, and have it signed before every delivery.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 List each unit and its rules
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Decide who signs, and for whom
fields.howto_step_3_title: 03 Have an attorney review the wording
fields.howto_step_1_des: Write down every rule your crew gives at setup, unit by unit: no shoes, no flips, small kids apart from big ones. Water slides and combos get their own extra rules. Each rule becomes a line the renter initials on the form.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Pick who signs for each kind of event. A rental booking needs the renter. A party or carnival needs a parent or guardian for each child, with every child's name and age. Set your own minimum age for each unit too.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Send the draft to an attorney licensed in your state before any renter signs it. Whether a release holds up depends on how it is written and the laws of your state, and some states limit waivers for minors. Ask about the parent section separately.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Describe your units, the rules, who signs, and the reminder in one prompt. Emergent builds the waiver, the database that stores every signed copy, and the route list your drivers check. Change any part later by prompting again.
fields.howto_step_5_title: 05 Set when the reminder goes out
fields.howto_step_5_des: Pick how long before delivery an unsigned booking triggers the email, such as 48 hours. Put the waiver link in the booking confirmation too. Renters who sign from it right away never get the reminder.
fields.howto_step_6_des: Have two crew members book fake rentals, one for a dry castle and one for a water slide. Let one skip signing to trigger the reminder. Check that the initials and the named adult show up on the route list.
fields.howto_step_7_des: When you change the wording, save it as a new version and keep old signatures tied to the version their signer saw. Ask your attorney or insurer how long to keep the records, and keep them searchable by renter name.

faq_plan.q: What is a bounce house waiver form?
faq_plan.a: A bounce house waiver form is a liability waiver that a renter or parent signs before anyone uses an inflatable. A liability waiver is a legal document in which a participant acknowledges the risks of an activity and agrees not to hold the organizing party responsible if an injury or incident occurs. This version adds the unit's own rules.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a bounce house waiver form?
faq_plan.a: Write down your units and their rules, have a licensed attorney where you operate review the release, then describe the form in one prompt to Emergent's AI form builder. It builds the waiver, the parent section, the reminder emails, and the database of signed copies.

faq_plan.q: Should the renter or each parent sign a bounce house waiver form?
faq_plan.a: The renter signs for every rental, since they accept the unit and its rules at delivery. When other families' children jump, as at a birthday party or a school carnival, also collect a parent or guardian signature for each child. Your attorney can tell you which signatures your state expects.

faq_plan.q: How is a bounce house waiver form different from other activity waivers?
faq_plan.a: It names the inflatable and the rules your crew gives at setup, and it often covers several children under one parent. Its release wording still goes to your attorney, who checks how your state treats waivers signed for minors. A yoga waiver form follows the same pattern, with class rules in place of unit rules.

faq_plan.q: Can parents sign a bounce house waiver form online before the party?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Text or email the link a week ahead, and each parent signs on a phone and lists every child they are bringing, with ages. The host sees who is still waiting before the day. Emergent builds the form with a database you own behind it.

faq_plan.q: What safety rules should a bounce house waiver form include?
faq_plan.a: Include the rules your crew already says out loud, written as short lines the renter initials. Start with your manufacturer's manual and your insurer's requirements, then add your own, such as a cap on riders or separate jumping times by size. Give water slides their own extra lines.

faq_plan.q: Should a bounce house waiver form name the adult supervising the inflatable?
faq_plan.a: Yes, ask for a name. A renter who books the unit may not be the person watching it all afternoon. A field for the supervising adult puts a real person on the record, and your driver can confirm that person during setup before leaving.

faq_plan.q: Can a bounce house waiver form remind renters who have not signed?
faq_plan.a: Yes. The app can email any renter still unsigned at a set time before delivery, with the waiver link in the message. Drivers see Signed or Waiting for each stop on the morning route. Emergent can also send Slack or in-app alerts to your office.

faq_plan.q: How long should a rental company keep each signed bounce house waiver form?
faq_plan.a: Keep them as long as your attorney or insurer advises for claims in your state, and store each one with its booking and the wording version the renter saw. Emergent puts no response caps on the form, and a full summer of rentals stays searchable in one place.

faq_plan.q: What goes on a bounce house waiver form besides the release wording?
faq_plan.a: Add the renter's contact details, the unit and delivery date, the initialed rules, the supervising adult, and each child's name and age where parents sign. A general liability waiver form carries the release alone. These lines tie the signature to one rental.

plan.angle: The top results for bounce house waiver form are printable PDFs and rental-company paperwork that stop at the wording and leave the renter with a clipboard on the lawn. This page shows the waiver working where bounce houses actually get used: a rental company that will not unload until the renter has signed, a birthday host collecting one signature per family with every child's age, a school carnival handing wristbands to signed children, and a water slide rental where the renter initials extra rules and names the adult who watches the slide. Release wording goes to an attorney licensed in the operator's state; the form records who signed, for which children, and when.
